-- Prueft, ob die Summe der Mengen die Teilnehmerzahl ist.
-- Grundlage fuer die Auslastung. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0)   AS menge,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status,
        extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int AS jahr,
        coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        count(*)                                                    AS zeilen,
        sum(pos.menge)                                              AS plaetze,
        sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive')          AS inklusive,
        sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat ~ 'weitere[ns]? Person') AS weitere,
        max((substring(pos.kat from '([0-9]+) Person'))::int)
            FILTER (WHERE pos.kat !~ 'weitere[ns]? Person')          AS basis_n
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4, 5
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'gebucht')                       AS buchungen,
        coalesce(sum(j.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'gebucht'), 0)    AS plaetze,
        round(coalesce(sum(j.netto) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN je_buchung j ON j.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Plaetze je Buchung
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Plaetze je Buchung' AS bereich,
           concat(coalesce(plaetze::text, 'leer'), ' plaetze') AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('zeilen im schnitt ', round(avg(zeilen), 2),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_buchung WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- B. Paketmodell: Basiszahl gegen eins plus inklusive
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Paketmodell',
           CASE
               WHEN basis_n IS NULL THEN 'keine basiszahl im namen'
               WHEN coalesce(inklusive, 0) = 0 THEN 'basiszahl ohne inklusive'
               WHEN basis_n = 1 + inklusive THEN 'basiszahl gleich eins plus inklusive'
               ELSE concat('abweichung basis ', basis_n, ' gegen ', 1 + inklusive)
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze im schnitt ', round(avg(plaetze), 2),
                  ' / weitere im schnitt ', round(avg(coalesce(weitere, 0)), 2))
    FROM je_buchung WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- C. Auslastung in Klassen, nur Termine ab 2023
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE
               WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
               ELSE 'unter 25 prozent'
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- D. Die Termine ueber 100 Prozent einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Ueberbuchung',
           concat(coalesce(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'ohne datum'), ' ',
                  left(coalesce(name, 'ohne name'), 42)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum,
                  ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum AND buchungen > 0

    -- E. Zeilen je Buchung gegen Plaetze
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Zeilen gegen Plaetze',
           concat(zeilen, ' zeilen'), count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / mit inklusive ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(inklusive, 0) > 0),
                  ' / mit weiterer person ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(weitere, 0) > 0))
    FROM je_buchung WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT
    'S34' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;
